findings.title: Mixed focus flag skipped after budgets refresh
findings.problem: onMaxFocus/onSoftFocus are now attached only when the field is already mixed at render time. If the budgets prop refreshes while a uniform, untouched field has focus and the selected users' values diverge, the field becomes mixed but its focus handler never ran, so clearedMixed is unset and getFieldDisplayValue renders 'Mixed' in the focused input. The card keyfilter allows digits, so typing appends to it ('Mixed7'), which goes through updateCategory as a dirty value that parseBudgetNumber rejects. Before this change the focus handler was unconditional.
findings.impact: The user sees 'Mixed' in a field they are editing, and typing produces an edited field with a non-negative validation error and a disabled Save until they clear it manually, which is the class of spurious error EPMCDME-16069 is meant to remove. Reachability is unconfirmed: the modal deliberately stays initialized across external budgets refreshes (useEffect keyed only on visible), but no trigger was found that refreshes budgets while a limit input has focus.
findings.recommendation: Attach the focus handlers unconditionally: onMaxFocus={() => clearMixedForTyping(`${value}-max`)} and onSoftFocus={() => clearMixedForTyping(`${value}-soft`)}. The flag is only read when the field is mixed and is removed on blur, so non-mixed behaviour (AC1/AC2) is unchanged. Add a test that rerenders with budgets that make a focused uniform field mixed, types a digit, and expects no non-negative error.
